core_principles: Authority, Clarity, Truth - Data must be unambiguous.
Medical Precision - Crisp borders, high contrast, sterile but approachable surfaces.
Control Room Layout - Dense, scanable grid structures that prioritize critical alerts.
Flat Solid Surfaces - No glassmorphism for health data to prevent visual refraction.

hierarchy.kpi_value: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-mono font-medium tracking-tighter text-slate-900
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data-Heavy). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), minimal shadow (shadow-sm). Max border-radius: rounded-lg (8px).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6) to avoid text collision with borders.

component_rules.buttons: Flat, crisp edges (rounded-md). Explicit hover states with higher contrast.
component_rules.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Zebra striping or subtle border-b on rows. Numeric data MUST use font-mono for vertical alignment.
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn Chart). MUST highlight the 2-8°C optimal range using a ReferenceArea with a subtle green tint (e.g., fill='#10B981' fillOpacity={0.1}). Line charts for temperature history.
component_rules.badges: Use for device states. Small text, pill shape, high contrast colors based on status.
component_rules.alerts: Use Shadcn Alert for thermal alerts. Critical alerts should have a solid 1px red border and light red background.
component_rules.icons: Use lucide-react (default). Stroke width 1.5 for a clean, technical look.

login.layout: Split screen. Left: Form centered in clean white container. Right: High-quality lab/warehouse image with a subtle medical blue tint overlay.

admin_dashboard.layout: Top Navigation (Logo, Language ES/EN Selector, User Dropdown). Main content: KPI Cards row -> Pending Devices row -> Active Alerts List -> Device Grid/Table.
admin_dashboard.kpi_cards: 4 columns: Total Active, Total Inactive, Pending Approvals, Critical Alerts.

device_detail.layout: Header with Device ID and Current Status/Temperature. Large Recharts historical line graph (showing last N hours) with 2-8°C safe zone highlighted. Event log/Alerts table below.

transporter_view.layout: Centered, focused layout. Enter Device Password -> View Single Device Status (Current Temp, Target Range, Simple Graph). Minimalist, high contrast for mobile viewing in trucks.

login_background.description: Clean laboratory/warehouse setting. To be used on the right side of the split-screen login.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='kpi-active-devices').

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply IBM Plex Sans (body) and Work Sans (headings) via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement language selector (ES/EN) in the top nav using React Context or i18next.
Build the 2FA enrollment modal with a mock QR code display (can be a generic SVG or a hardcoded image for now).
Create the device pending approval flow: List pending devices -> Admin clicks approve -> status changes to active.
In the device details chart, draw a ReferenceArea between y=2 and y=8 to visually indicate the safe cold-chain zone.
Use mock data for the 10-second polling simulation (the actual hardware POST /api/temperatura can be mocked via a frontend setInterval that updates a global state/context for the demo).
Ensure the Transporter view is completely isolated. They just enter the hardware password and see that one specific device's temp.
